name: Michigan Cubing Club Alpha 2015
information: Thanks to many generous donations from previous competitors, this competition will be free of charge. However, to ensure that the list of pre-registered competitors accurately reflects the number of people attending the event, we will be collecting a $5 deposit via PayPal which can be refunded the day of the competition, or donated to the organizers for future competitions. This deposit will not be refunded if you find that you cannot attend the event.
